access_detail: Public document search (Kendo JavaScript app; the old querydef.aspx URL redirects to /edmsv2). Noncompliance reports and SPOC written unauthorized-discharge notification reports are filed per facility; whether sewer overflow reports are indexed by type was not confirmed. No list, map or API of overflows.

name: LDEQ Single Point of Contact (SPOC) incident reporting
access_detail: Phone line (M-F 8:00-4:30) and an online incident form (internet.deq.louisiana.gov ... INCIDENT-REPORTING-SPILL-INCIDENT-RELEASE). Emergencies go to the State Police hotline; written "UNAUTHORIZED DISCHARGE NOTIFICATION REPORT" within 7 calendar days (LAC 33:I.3925). No public output of incidents found.

name: LAC 33:I Chapter 39, Notification Regulations and Procedures for Unauthorized Discharges
access_detail: Emergency discharges: Louisiana State Police hotline promptly (no later than 1 hour per the rule as commonly summarized; not re-read); non-emergency over a reportable quantity: LDEQ within 24 hours; written report within 7 calendar days. Search snippets indicate a definition excluding material in domestic sewage; whether sewer overflows fall under Chapter 39 or only under LPDES permit conditions is unconfirmed.
status_reason: Regulator duty only; no public-notice duty found.
